For details about the project, refer to [docs/project_overview.md].

When generating code, follow these guidelines: 
- If you are adding a new file or a new deployable component, follow the instructions in [.github/instructions/project-structure.instructions.md] to ensure the project structure remains consistent and organized.
- If you are adding documentation, refer to [.github/instructions/docs-structure.instructions.md] for guidance on the folder structure and formatting standards.
- If you are implementing a feature for a component, refer to:
  - [docs/<component-name>/design.md] for documentation on the component's overall design.
  - [docs/<component-name>/adr/*] for architecture decision records for this component.
